# Fundemics Tutorials

> Premier Academic Coaching Institute for Classes I–XII across ICSE, ISC, CBSE, and State Board in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India.

Fundemics Tutorials LLP provides high-impact foundation and board examination preparation with small batch sizes, experienced faculty mentors, synchronized City Montessori School (CMS) curriculum pacing, and verified student rankers.

## Core Offerings

- [Courses](https://fundemicstutorials.in/#courses): Academic coaching for Classes I–XII across ICSE, ISC, CBSE, and Uttar Pradesh State Board.
- [CMS Batches](https://fundemicstutorials.in/#cms-batches): Dedicated batches synchronized with City Montessori School academic calendar and comparative exams.
- [Student Rankers](https://fundemicstutorials.in/rankers): Verified academic achievements, board top scorers, and merit archives across ICSE & ISC.
- [Faculty](https://fundemicstutorials.in/teachers): Senior educators led by Mayank Aggarwal (Founder & Director) and Manish K. Verma (Co-Founder, IIT Dhanbad).
- [Centres](https://fundemicstutorials.in/#centres): Lucknow campus locations in Triveni Nagar (Flagship Centre), Faizullaganj, and Aliganj.
- [Inquiries & Admissions](https://fundemicstutorials.in/queries): Online inquiry desk and admissions counselling.
